what_it_shows: Street-level facade of The Reef Hotel & Residences: the white multi-storey building with glass front and the teal 'The Reef, Hotel & Residences' sign, in daylight.
notes: YouTube 'Reef Hotel - Subic Bay' by Trip ni Gio (1245 s total; I only inspected 0-300 s). Single shot, 257 to 263.5 s, muted, 720 px wide. Cropped to 540x360 from x=100 to remove the 'Trip in GO' logo at top-left; the 'THE' of the sign is partly clipped at the left edge in the later frames. Camera drifts slowly (a slow pan) and no presenter or people are in the cut. Poster = 260 s frame, same crop, 540 px wide. Other Reef candidates were rejected: eB4_t2w1e8o (A&D Travels room tour, shaky and dim, a person in a mirror), HB_zHOOkDck (Celine Aguilar room tour, the 265-290 s stretch is a street crowd), 4t7wbjcyScY (sunset cruise, generic bay view). 'Central Park Reef' videos are a different property and were excluded. Rating 3/5.
